tasks.short: Provide a urology consultation to other physicians.

steps.what: Read the physician request already on the consult
Provide urology consultation to physicians or other health professionals
State the clinical question, her advice, and the physician
Copy that stated advice into the consult reply
Check the reply carries her advice and no extra finding
Send the accepted consult reply to the outside physician

tasks.design: She provides the consultation herself, then states the clinical question, her advice and the requesting physician on the {OTHER} record. A later deterministic copy places only those fields into the reply and does not choose the advice or wait for its own check. She checks that the reply carries her advice and adds no finding, and only that accepted reply is sent to the physician outside the hospital. A rejection sends nothing.
tasks.previous_blocker: The reply had to be composed by hand after the consult, and a wrong advice can harm the patient.
tasks.enabler_now: The question, advice and physician she states are enough for a field copy into the reply that already leaves the hospital.
tasks.still_hard: Giving the consultation and choosing the advice stay with her. A blank advice is not invented.
tasks.human_edge: She is accountable for the advice. A copied reply cannot examine the patient.
tasks.altitude: The consultation stays in her week. Only composing and sending an accepted reply to an outside physician leaves it. She gains no right to skip the advice.

reach.task: Act on the urology consultation she accepted
reach.learn: The question she was asked and the advice she stated

evidence.claim: Copying a stated clinical question, advice and requesting physician into a consult reply does not choose the advice.

assumptions: The patient id is already on the consult in the {OTHER} record. She does not re-key it.
Fields she states before the copy are the clinical question, her advice and the requesting physician. A blank advice or a blank physician means no copy.
Try the record's own reply message before any custom copy.
The copy places only those stated fields, does not rephrase the advice, does not add a finding, and does not wait for its own check.
Today she writes that reply herself. The machine is only the later copy and the later send.
She does not also type the reply. The check compares the advice with what she stated. Any change to the copy voids acceptance.
Rejection sends nothing. The send is the written reply that already leaves to a physician outside the hospital. An in-house talk has no send.
The reply is not uploaded to an external model. There is no ambient recording.
A rejected reply is dropped in the check, so upkeep hours are zero.
unknowns: How often this clinic's consult is only a talk, with no written reply to a physician outside the hospital.
research_questions: How often a consult ends with no outside reply, so the copy and the send do not fire.

already_counted.description: The check that the reply carries her advice and adds no finding, already counted in the review step before the send.

incremental.description: A rejected reply is dropped in the check. There is no later rewrite queue, so upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: a year of consults that stay a talk inside the hospital, so the reply rarely leaves. High: a year of written replies to outside physicians, each sent once after she has checked the advice. She still gives the consultation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Direct nurses and residents on patient care.

steps.what: Hear how the nurses and residents left the ward
Direct nurses, residents and other staff to provide patient care
Decide the next patient action and remain with the staff

tasks.design: She hears the ward, directs the nurses, residents and other staff, and stays while they provide the patient care. Nothing in this task is copied or sent. A later note that she directed the ward is a different task, and she does not approve her own save of it.
tasks.previous_blocker: The direction depends on the patient in front of the staff, and a wrong order can harm that patient.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing in this task became a field another system can carry. The direction is still spoken on the ward.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing the next action and seeing whether the staff have understood it stay with her.
tasks.human_edge: She is accountable for the care she directs. A stored sentence cannot watch the ward.
tasks.altitude: Directing the nurses, residents and other staff stays in her week. Nothing leaves it. She gains no new decision right.

reach.task: Carry out the patient care she directed
reach.learn: Which patient action she directed on the ward

evidence.claim: Directing nurses, residents and other staff on the ward is spoken work, and a later note of that direction is a different task.

assumptions: The direction is given in person to nurses, residents or other staff of this hospital. It is not a message to someone outside.
No structured input is required. She hears the ward herself.
A later line in the record that she directed the ward is a different task and is outside these shares.
She does not send an order and does not approve her own note.
Upkeep hours are zero because no machine step is added.
unknowns: Whether this clinic writes the direction into the record inside this task or in a separate record task.
research_questions: How often a direction is changed again before the staff leave the bedside.

incremental.description: No machine step is added, so upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A year of ward rounds stays in the room. She still hears the report, still directs the staff, and still decides the next patient action.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prescribe medications for erectile and related problems.

steps.what: Read the recorded erectile dysfunction, infertility or ejaculation problems
Prescribe medications to treat these patients in the room
State the drug, the dose, the route and this patient
Copy those stated medications onto the prescription
Check the prescription keeps her drug, dose and these patients
Send the accepted prescription to the patient's pharmacy

tasks.design: She prescribes the medications in the room, then states the drug, the dose, the route and the patient on the {OTHER} record. A later deterministic copy places only those fields on the prescription and does not choose the drug or wait for its own check. She checks that the prescription keeps her drug, her dose and these patients, and only that accepted prescription is sent to the pharmacy. A rejection sends nothing. She remains the named prescriber.
tasks.previous_blocker: The prescription had to be keyed by hand, and a wrong drug or dose can harm the patient.
tasks.enabler_now: The drug, dose, route and patient she states are enough for a field copy into the prescription that already goes to the pharmacy.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing the medication and explaining it stay with her. A blank drug is not invented, and a copy must not change the drug.
tasks.human_edge: She is accountable for the drug and the dose. A copied prescription cannot examine the patient.
tasks.altitude: Choosing the medication stays in her week. Only composing and sending an accepted prescription leaves it. She gains no right to skip the choice of drug.

reach.task: Dispense the medications on the accepted prescription
reach.learn: The drug, dose, route and patient she stated

evidence.claim: Copying a stated drug, dose, route and patient onto a prescription does not choose the medication.

assumptions: The patient id is already on the visit in the {OTHER} record. She does not re-key it.
Fields she states before the copy are the drug name, the dose, the route and the patient. A blank drug, a blank dose or a blank patient means no copy.
Try the record's own prescription message before any custom copy.
The copy places only those stated fields, does not change the drug, does not suggest another medication, and does not wait for its own check.
Today she writes that prescription herself. The machine is only the later copy and the later send.
She does not also type the prescription. The check compares the drug, the dose and the patient with what she stated. Any change voids acceptance.
Rejection sends nothing. The send is the prescription that already goes to the patient's pharmacy. A spoken order to a ward nurse is the in-room step, not this send.
She remains the named prescriber. The copy is not a decision about which drug to use.
The prescription is not uploaded to an external model. There is no ambient recording.
A rejected prescription is dropped in the check, so upkeep hours are zero.
unknowns: Whether this clinic's prescriptions already leave as a structured message, or she still phones the pharmacy for some of them.
research_questions: How often a visit ends with no prescription, so the copy and the send do not fire.

already_counted.description: The check that the prescription keeps her drug, her dose and these patients, already counted in the review step before the send.

incremental.description: A rejected prescription is dropped in the check. There is no later rewrite queue, so upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: a year in which she still phones some pharmacies, so the send rarely replaces that call. High: a year in which each accepted prescription is sent once. She still chooses the drug, the dose and the patient.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Teach and train medical and clinical staff.

steps.what: Read the case she means to teach the clinical staff
Teach and train the medical and clinical staff beside the case
Decide which point that staff must still practise

tasks.design: She reads the case, teaches and trains the medical and clinical staff beside it, and decides which point they must still practise. Nothing in this task is copied or sent. A text she still reads aloud does not shorten the teaching, and she does not approve her own save of a lesson.
tasks.previous_blocker: The teaching depends on the case and on whether the staff have followed it, and a wrong point can harm a later patient.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing in this task became a field another system can carry. The teaching is still spoken beside the case.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing what to teach and seeing whether the staff have learned it stay with her.
tasks.human_edge: She is accountable for what the staff are trained to do. A stored sentence cannot watch them practise.
tasks.altitude: Teaching and training the staff stay in her week. Nothing leaves it. She gains no new decision right.

reach.task: Apply the point she taught on the next case
reach.learn: Which clinical point she trained and where it stops

evidence.claim: Teaching and training medical and clinical staff beside a case is spoken work, and a text she still reads aloud does not shorten that teaching.

assumptions: The teaching is given in person to medical and clinical staff of this hospital. It is not a message to someone outside.
No structured input is required. She reads the case herself.
A lesson she writes down is outside these shares when she still teaches it herself.
She does not send a lesson and does not approve her own note.
Upkeep hours are zero because no machine step is added.
unknowns: Whether this clinic counts preparation of the case inside this task or in a separate preparation task.
research_questions: How often a teaching session has no case prepared ahead, so the read step is only a glance.

incremental.description: No machine step is added, so upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A year of teaching stays in the room. She still reads the case, still teaches the staff, and still decides what they must practise.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The consultation, the direction of staff, the choice of drug and the teaching stay in her week. Only composing and sending an accepted consult reply, or an accepted prescription, leaves it. She gains no new decision right.
skills_to_grow: State the drug, the dose, the route and the patient before any prescription is copied.
Reject a prescription that changes the drug, and reject a consult reply that adds a finding.
Leave directing the staff and teaching the staff in her own hands.
role.ambitious_version: The week does not grow. She does not take more consults, more prescriptions or more teaching because a reply can be sent.
